about: Ten reference routes across Trentino and Alto Adige, plus two extras inside the northern half of the region. Coordinates are OSM-derived where a place, peak or path node exists (precise to ~50 m); huts without an OSM node use the published coordinate and are marked in tests/reference-routes.md. reference.scale says which walking-time convention the reference uses: SAT/CAI is the Alpine club rule (4 km/h flat, 400 m/h up, 800 m/h down), which is also what our model implements; Komoot and Outdooractive are their own, usually faster.

routes.name: Martignano (Pinara) to Monte Calisio on foot, SAT 401

points.name: Pinara, Via ai Bolleri, Martignano (~390 m)

reference.scale: SAT/CAI - the SAT trail cadastre 2019 and OSM relation 7009824 tag SAT 401 as 3.190-3.21 km, 708 m, duration:forward 2:00 (backward 1:25). The often-quoted '3 h' is Outdooractive's 7 km LOOP up 401 and down 402, not the one-way line.

routes.name: Molveno (Ciclamino) to Rifugio Pedrotti alla Tosa on foot, SAT 319

points.name: Baita Ciclamino, end of Via Dolomiti, Molveno (~950 m)

reference.scale: SAT/CAI - OSM relation 313435 / SAT cadastre: 9.11-9.47 km, 1560 m, duration:forward 4:30. SAT measures 319 from Ciclamino (950 m), not from Molveno village (864 m), which would add ~1.4 km and ~110 m. 'SAT 319B' does not exist in the 2019 cadastre.

routes.name: Vallesinella to Rifugio Brentei on foot, SAT 317 then 318 Bogani

points.name: Rifugio Maria e Alberto ai Brentei (2182 m)

reference.scale: SAT/CAI - SAT 317 to Casinei 1.49 km/~50 min, then SAT 318 'Bogani' 3.73 km/100 min tagged on the OSM relation. Ardito walks it in 2 h 30, Outdooractive 5 h out and back. E to Casinei, EE on the Bogani.

routes.name: Sardagna to Cima Verde (Monte Bondone) on foot

reference.scale: Composite ESTIMATE on the SAT/CAI scale: SAT 645 Piedicastello-Vaneze (6.56 km/1087 m/3:00) minus the part below Sardagna, then Vaneze-Norge-Vason-Viote, then SAT 636 to Cima Verde (relation 1169757: 5.01 km/605 m/2:40 to Cornetto). No single published Sardagna-Cima Verde reference exists.

routes.name: Trento to Riva del Garda by car, SS45bis Gardesana

reference.scale: Free-flow road-planner estimate: OSRM 44.2 km/49 min, Valhalla 42.4 km/65 min, aggregators 41-42 km/34-43 min. Both endpoints are pedestrian squares, which is deliberate: it is what a user clicks.

routes.name: Trento to Rovereto by bike, Ciclabile della Valle dell'Adige

points.name: Ponte San Lorenzo, Ciclovia della Valle dell'Adige, Trento

reference.scale: Leisure cycling 15-18 km/h over 25.19 km measured on the cycleway (84-101 min); BRouter's sporty trekking model gives 72 min (~21 km/h). Elevation is BRouter's +31/-34 m with a 3 m threshold: the valley floor is flat.

routes.name: Bolzano to Merano by bike, Etschradweg / Ciclabile dell'Adige

points.name: Bolzano, Ponte Talvera cycle junction (268 m)

reference.scale: Leisure cycling 15-18 km/h over 30.3 km measured (101-121 min); the tourist boards allow 2 h 15-2 h 20 including stops. Merano is HIGHER than Bolzano: +70/-30 m along the path.

routes.name: Ortisei to Rifugio Firenze / Regensburger Huette on foot

points.name: Ortisei, parish church / Streda Sacun (1236 m)

reference.scale: CAI/SAT rule (4 km/h, 400 m/h up, 800 m/h down, max + half the lesser) over the measured 9.4 km / 887 m gross: 211 min. The published figure on it./de.wikipedia is 2 h 30, which is an ascent-rate number (800 m at 400 m/h) that ignores the 9.4 km of horizontal; the hut's own 'about 4 h' is trail 4 from the village. No one-way Komoot or Outdooractive tour exists for this pair.

routes.name: Riva del Garda to Lago di Tenno on foot, SAT 401

points.name: Riva del Garda, Torre Apponale / Piazza 3 Novembre (~67 m)

reference.scale: CAI/SAT rule over the measured 9.4 km via the Cascata del Varone (8.3 km without the waterfall), 576 m gross: 186 min. No published one-way tour exists; the Outdooractive/Sentres 'Da Varone al Lago di Tenno' is a 10.7 km circuit, and that site carries two versions of it whose times differ by 50%.

routes.name: Trento to Cima Tosa, car to Molveno then on foot

points.name: Molveno, Pradel gondola valley station (905 m)

reference.scale: Car Trento-Molveno 42.2 km / 43 min free-flow (SS12 - SS43 Val di Non - SS421, NOT the SS45bis), then Molveno/Pradel-Pedrotti 240 min / +1617 m and Pedrotti-Cima Tosa 150 min / +645 m. NOTE: Pedrotti to the summit is EEA on the equipped SAT 358 followed by an F/PD alpine route with 25 m of UIAA II+ - rope, harness and descender are mandatory. A refusal is the correct answer. The often-repeated '2014 Canalone Neri collapse' could not be confirmed in any source; what is documented is the shrinking summit ice cap (3173 m in guidebooks, 3136 m measured in 2015).

walk.scale: The walking half only. Molveno/Pradel to Rifugio Pedrotti 10.1 km / 240 min / +1617 m (Outdooractive; SAT and the hut post 4 h 30 from Molveno), then Pedrotti to the summit +645 m (it.wikipedia). RE-BASELINED 2026-09-15 to grade A: the via normale above Pedrotti is a guided summer climb on glacier and UIAA II+ rock (rope, harness and descender mandatory, guided as a two-day ascent), which is grade A ground, so the row is now asked at A rather than refused at EEA and retried. The time uses the upper published figure for that stretch, 180 min rather than 150 (vienormali and the guides quote 2 h 30 to 3 h one way), giving 240 + 180 = 420 min; the 150 min on it.wikipedia is a plain ascent-rate number that does not price alpine pacing. Distance is an ESTIMATE, 11.5-13 km: no source covers the line end to end.

routes.name: Compatsch (Alpe di Siusi) to Rifugio Bolzano / Schlernhaus on foot

reference.scale: The hut's own page: trails 10-5-1, 3 h 20, 790 m. The CAI/AVS rule in its max-plus-half form gives 194 min for the same line, so reference and model agree on the convention.

routes.name: Bolzano to Ora / Auer by bike, Etschradweg south

points.name: Bolzano, Ponte Talvera cycle junction (~265 m)

reference.scale: Cycling at 15 km/h; cross-checks with the tourist board's 2 h 30 for the full 37 km Bolzano-Salorno (~14.8 km/h). Net drop about 50 m.

routes.name: Cognola to Monte Calisio on foot, SAT 402 (the Via Asiago side)

reference.scale: SAT/CAI - OSM relation 129334 / SAT cadastre: 4.550 km, 720 m, duration:forward 2:10. This is the trail that actually starts on the Cognola / Via Asiago side of Trento; SAT 401 starts at Martignano.

routes.name: Trento station to Riva del Garda by car (drivable start, quality check)

reference.scale: Same reference as riva-car; this entry exists to measure route quality from a start the car graph can reach.

routes.name: Riva del Garda by bike to Varone, then on foot to Lago di Tenno

reference.scale: Whole trip: 4.1 km ridden to Varone plus 5.28 km walked. Scored on the walking half.

walk.scale: Varone to Lago di Tenno measured at 5.28 km / +453 m; the CAI/SAT rule gives 113 min (horizontal 79, vertical 68, max plus half the lesser). Published references for this stretch are all loops from Varone.
